name: Silicon Matrix (RigForge)
about: Plan, compare and check PC builds with Indian prices: bottleneck checks, FPS estimates, power supply sizing, running costs and a hardware scan of your own PC.

name: NAVIK Simulator
about: A web simulator showing how NAVIK, our autonomous driving bot, uses its sensors to drive a vehicle on Indian roads.

name: Kumari Kandam: The Lost Mythology
about: An interactive atlas asking whether a lost continent lay south of India. Follows Lemuria from Sclater's 1864 land bridge to Theosophy and the Tamil Kumari Kandam tradition, then tests it against plate tectonics.

name: Škoda Volkswagen Group India Showcase
about: Independent guide to Volkswagen Group brands in India: Škoda, Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, Lamborghini, Bentley, MAN and Scania. Compare models, prices, engines and safety.

name: Oru Payanam Aayiram Kathaigal
about: A cinematic web journey inspired by Tamil Nadu's vintage TNSTC buses. Board at Villupuram, pick a destination such as Chennai, Madurai, Thanjavur, Kanyakumari or Ooty, and explore its heritage, food, cinema and stories through illustration, a retro bus-console interface, audio and animation.

name: Lumisphere
about: Illuminate the web. An interactive 3D personal showcase exploring light, ambience and visual design, where every pixel, transition and sound cue is crafted as part of the experience.
